Package org.jdesktop.lg3d.displayserver.nativewindow.x11

Class X11CompositedWindowHost

java.lang.Object
org.jdesktop.lg3d.displayserver.nativewindow.x11.X11CompositedWindowHost
All Implemented Interfaces:
CompositedWindowHost
public final class X11CompositedWindowHost extends Object implements CompositedWindowHost
The production CompositedWindowHost: for a redirected client window it wires the shared pixel pipeline into a Swing surface the 2D desktop can embed.

Per window it builds a CompositeWindowImageLoader (the WindowPixelSource reading the Composite NameWindowPixmap), a SwingCompositedWindowSink (the 2D CompositedWindowSink) and a CompositedWindowPipeline joining them, registers the pipeline as the window's X11Compositor.DamageListener so repaints flow into the canvas, and primes it with one full-window read. dispose() unregisters the listener and tears down the damage/pixmap tracking.

This class handles the display half only and holds no Java 3D and no X11Client reference. Input forwarding is attached separately by whoever owns the X11Client — new SwingX11InputForwarder( compositor, client, hosted.getComponent()) — keeping this host decoupled from the window-manager's client objects.
